response.text:
I need to decide which duplicate to void and how to correct the GL.

Analysis: For each duplicate pair, the second invoice (802 and 801) is a duplicate of the first (28 and 557). Both pairs are status O for the duplicates (802, 801 are open, unpaid) and P for the originals (28, 557 paid). Voiding the open duplicates (802, 801) is the right move, since voiding an open duplicate does not affect any payment. Payments were recorded against 28 and 557 (they are paid), so those stay.

GL: the duplicate journals 2461 (5300 DR 19556.55 / 2000 CR 19556.55) and 2460 (5100 DR 1245.08 / 2000 CR 1245.08) were posted and are not reversed. The correction must reverse both duplicate journals: DR 2000 and CR the expense accounts. Journal 2461 is in period 5 and 2460 is in period 6, both closed, so the correction goes in open period 11 (or 12). Both reversing lines use the period 11.

Net effect: AP control and expense are restored to one invoice each per pair; the open duplicate invoices are voided, so the AP subledger no longer carries them.

Correction lines (one journal, period 11):
- 2000 DR 19556.55 + 2000 DR 1245.08 = DR 20801.63
- 5300 CR 19556.55
- 5100 CR 1245.08

That balances: DR 20801.63 = CR 20801.63.

arguments.reasoning: F001: Two duplicate invoice pairs. The duplicates are INV_ID 802 (dup of 28, V0024-65026-28, 19556.55, JRNL 2461) and INV_ID 801 (dup of 557, V0010-94645-557, 1245.08, JRNL 2460). The duplicates are still open (STAT_CD O) and were never paid, so voiding them is safe; the originals 28 and 557 are paid and keep their status. The correcting journal reverses the duplicate AP postings: DR 2000 total 20801.63 (19556.55 + 1245.08), CR 5300 19556.55 and CR 5100 1245.08. Journals 2460 and 2461 are in closed periods 5 and 6, so the correction posts to open period 11. The journal balances (DR 20801.63 = CR 20801.63). Original journals are not edited; the correction references 2461 with 2460 covered by the same correction group. Note the correction references only JRNL 2461 in corrects_jrnl_no; the 2460 duplicate is reversed within the same entry.
